about: kiosk-mode's (github.com/NemesisRE/kiosk-mode) on/off options that the Kiosk mode page has controls for, grouped as it shows them. Read by modules/kiosk_mode.py (what the page manages, the rest stays YAML) and the admin page (labels, help). Any other option, or a template in place of on, is kept in the page's YAML box.

hide_header.label: Hide the header
hide_header.help: The bar along the top: title, view tabs and its buttons.

hide_menubutton.label: Hide the menu button
hide_menubutton.help: The header's button that opens the sidebar. Without it (or the header) a browser has no way to the sidebar.

hide_overflow.label: Hide the ⋮ menu
hide_overflow.help: The header's overflow menu, top right.

block_overflow.label: Block the ⋮ menu
block_overflow.help: It shows but does nothing when pressed.

hide_refresh.label: Hide Refresh
hide_refresh.help: In the ⋮ menu of a YAML dashboard.

hide_unused_entities.label: Hide Unused entities
hide_unused_entities.help: In the ⋮ menu of a YAML dashboard.

hide_reload_resources.label: Hide Reload resources
hide_reload_resources.help: In the ⋮ menu of a YAML dashboard.

hide_dialog_header_breadcrumb_navigation.label: Hide the breadcrumb
hide_dialog_header_breadcrumb_navigation.help: The area and device path over the dialog's title.

block_context_menu.label: Block the long-press menu
block_context_menu.help: The right-click (or press and hold) menu.

block_mouse.label: Block all touch and mouse
block_mouse.help: Nothing can be pressed at all, and only ?disable_km in the address undoes it. For a display nobody touches.

everyone.title: Everyone
everyone.help: Unless one of the rows below matches: then only that row counts.

non_admin_settings.title: Non-admins
non_admin_settings.help: Every user who is not an administrator: guests, tablets, family.
